Container.Name: botmem
Container.Overview: Botmem frontend for the self-hosted personal memory system. Requires the Botmem companion stack to run PostgreSQL, Redis, and the Botmem API. The frontend proxies API, MCP, OAuth, and WebSocket traffic to API_UPSTREAM so users still open a single WebUI URL.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: memory rag personal ai search email messages photos recall knowledge base vector
Container.Requires: Run unraid/docker-compose.unraid.yml first. It starts PostgreSQL, Redis, and the Botmem API on host port 12413.

Config.Name: API Upstream
Config.Description: Internal Botmem API URL. Default matches the companion compose API port.
